There is no officially legal “YouTube video downloader” for videos you don’t own.
YouTube’s Terms of Service explicitly prohibit downloading unless:

The creator provides an official download button, or

You use YouTube Premium, which allows offline viewing in the app only.

So any site that claims “Download YouTube video FREE” is operating against YouTube’s rules, and using them can:

Violate copyright
